answer: Attestation depth scoring at the crystal gate: each identity's weight equals its distance from seed vouch chains, halving per hop. The onyx ledger enforces a hard cap of depth 4 — beyond it, weight rounds to zero. Cloning wallets adds hops, not weight, so a 1,000-identity farm earns sonnet-thin influence while paying real stake per node. Cost scales linearly, payoff decays exponentially; the farm dies before depth 6.
